Self.Wiki: Ride jump (formerly Big Jump; handled by the game's CSRideJumpRegionManImpl). A spiritspring: entering it launches the player upwards. An SFX marks it. For a spiritspring that can be sealed by an event flag, see DLC Ride Jump.

JumpHeight.Wiki: Height the player will move upwards when activating this spiritspring.

SfxID.Wiki: SFX shown at the spiritspring. A negative value uses the GameSystemCommonParam default. Retail uses 807100 (70 regions) and 807101 (14).

UnkT08.Wiki: Nightreign only. Read as an integer for MSB version 0x4B and later. Retail uses 200 (one region uses 201).
